name: What questions should you ask before hiring a home extension contractor in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What questions should you ask before hiring a home extension contractor in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What questions should you ask before hiring a home extension contractor in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor for a home extension, homeowners should ask questions that reveal both experience and process. It helps to ask how many similar additions they have completed in the area, how they handle permits and plan review, and whether they coordinate directly with engineers and designers. You should also ask who will supervise the job on site, how often progress updates are provided, and how change orders are approved. A clear payment schedule, insurance verification, and a detailed written scope are essential. If the contractor cannot explain how they deal with hidden conditions, utility upgrades, or inspection delays, that is a warning sign. The best contractor is not just the cheapest bid; it is the one who can manage complexity, communicate clearly, and keep the project aligned with the budget and design goals. In a market like Los Angeles, local permitting knowledge matters as much as construction skill.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar completed additions, permit experience, structural coordination, timeline, payment schedule, allowances, insurance, and how change orders are handled. You should also confirm who manages the project and who will be on-site day to day.
